name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on the incline bench with your feet on the ground. Raise the dumbbells until you have straight arms.
2
Lower the dumbbells to your mid chest
3
Raise the dumbbells until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Flys
cardText:
1
Lay flat on the bench and place your feet on the ground.
2
Begin the exercise with the dumbbells held together above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
3
Simultaneously lower the weights to either side.
4
Pause when the weights are parallel to the bench, then raise your arms to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cardText:
1
Start by lying flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
2
Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your palms facing forward.
3
Engage your core and press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
cardText:
1
Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
2
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
3
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
4
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Decline Alternating Single Arm Press
cardText:
1
Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
2
Break at one of your arms first bringing that arm to your side while keeping the other arm extended.
3
Press the dumbbell back to the ceiling. Fully extend that arm before initiating on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
2
Break at the elbows and bring your upper arms to your side.
3
Once your upper arms have reached your side, press the dumbbells back to the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Decline Chest Fly
cardText:
1
Lay flat on a decline bench press with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
2
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows. Bring the dumbbells out to the side, stopping the dumbbells before they pass your torso.
3
Bring the dumbbells together to finish the rep.

name: Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
3
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
3
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
4
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press
cardText:
1
Start by laying on a decline bench with two dumbbells.
2
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
3
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
4
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
5
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on a decline bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
2
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
3
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
4
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
3
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on the incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
3
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly
cardText:
1
Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
2
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
3
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
4
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Chest Fly
cardText:
1
Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you in an overhand grip.
2
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
3
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
4
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
cardText:
1
Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
2
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement. You should have an overhand grip.
3
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
4
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on a flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
3
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
4
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
2
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
3
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
4
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
2
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
3
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
4
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Press
cardText:
1
Start by laying on a bench with two dumbbells.
2
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
3
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
4
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
5
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Elevated Pushup
cardText:
1
Start by placing two dumbbells on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
2
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the dumbbells, keeping your arms straight.
3
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
4
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
5
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Pushup to Renegade Row
cardText:
1
Start in a high plank position with a pair of dumbbells positioned under your shoulders. Your hands should grip the dumbbells, palms facing each other.
2
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you row one dumbbell up towards your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
3
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press
cardText:
1
Start in a bench press position with two dumbbells.
2
Break at one of your elbows first while keeping the other elbow extended.
3
Your working arm should reach your side before pressing back to the ceiling.
4
Then alternate to the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cardText:
1
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Dumbbell High Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
2
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
3
Lower the bar to your mid chest
4
Raise the dumbbells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
2
Lower the dumbbells to your lower chest.
3
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Dip
cardText:
1
Use a dip belt to attach a dumbbell to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
2
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
3
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Dumbbell Neutral High Incline Bench Press
cardText:
1
Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells with neutral grip at shoulders.
2
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend without locking elbows.
3
Lower slowly to shoulder level and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
cardText:
1
Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with slight elbow bend.
2
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
3
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Floor Fly
cardText:
1
Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with palms turned downward.
2
Lower arms out wide while maintaining internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
3
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Single Arm Floor Fly
cardText:
1
Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with palm turned downward.
2
Lower arm out wide while keeping internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
3
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Dumbbell Larsen Press
cardText:
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding dumbbells above chest.
2
Lower dumbbells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Chest Press
cardText:
1
Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with arm extended.
2
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping torso stable and level.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Floor Fly
cardText:
1
Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
2
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
3
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
cardText:
1
Sit on high incline bench holding dumbbell at shoulder with arm bent.
2
Press dumbbell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
3
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
cardText:
1
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
2
Lower the bar to your mid chest
3
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Larsen Press
cardText:
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one dumbbell above chest.
2
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.
